A '''Kallinn''' was a type of [[Bow/Legends|bow]] used by the [[Ebranite]] [[Rith Tar'ak]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Adventure Journal 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Kallinn was mentioned in the "[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives (article)|Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]" article included in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|eleventh issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' published by [[West End Games]] in [[November]] [[1996]]. The article was written by [[Craig Robert Carey]] and [[Trevor J. Wilson]].<ref name="Adventure Journal 11" />
